scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @openspace/web" "npm run dev --workspace @openspace/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @openspace/shared && npm run build --workspace @openspace/api && npm run build --workspace @openspace/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @openspace/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @openspace/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @openspace/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @openspace/api && npm run lint --workspace @openspace/web
scripts.check: npm run check:manifests && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
